svg.aria-label: themis. On the left, a long page of rules for an AI assistant keeps scrolling: most lines are filler, a few matter. Lines travel through a ring: the filler drops away, the few that matter go on and land in two short pages with the same three lines, one read by Claude and one read by the other assistants. In trial runs the page came out short and complete 9 times out of 9; without themis, 0 out of 9.
